title: Preserve pending edits through a history preview
steps: Select the Rectangle tool and draw a rectangle while background saves are delayed.
Before autosave finishes, open History and request a preview of Before current edit; observe past the autosave interval and save-delay release.
Exit the version preview and inspect the live workspace.
Return to Projects and reopen Version Preview Study.

video_guide.summary: Preview the earlier empty version, then exit and reopen the file from Dashboard. The current rectangle remains available after both exiting the preview and reopening the file.

chapters.note: Previewing version: Before current edit opens on the earlier empty canvas.
The historical preview is still empty and offers Exit and Restore.

chapters.label: Exit preview and reopen the live file

chapters.note: After exiting preview and reopening the file from Dashboard, the rectangle remains visible on the canvas and in Layers.
